item.title: Memo: Linux distribution vendor SUSE is laying off ~10% of its staff, saying "automation and AI are fundamentally shifting how software companies operate" (Liam Proven/The Register)
item.description:
Liam Proven / The Register:
Memo: Linux distribution vendor SUSE is laying off ~10% of its staff, saying “automation and AI are fundamentally shifting how software companies operate”  —  ‘Modern tooling is already changing our daily workflows’ says CEO at open source biz  —  One in ten employees at SUSE …

Original (direct link): https://www.theregister.com/software/2026/11/02/suse-to-cut-one-in-ten-employees-because-of-ai/5306950

item.title: OpenAI launches the Grid Protectors Program, a US effort for its future data center campuses to reduce electricity demand when the grid is under strain (OpenAI)
item.description:
OpenAI:
OpenAI launches the Grid Protectors Program, a US effort for its future data center campuses to reduce electricity demand when the grid is under strain  —  Today we're launching the Grid Protectors Program, a national effort to support affordable, reliable electricity for families and businesses in the communities where we build.

Original (direct link): https://openai.com/index/grid-protectors-program

item.description:

DeepSeek releases a “creator mode” that allows users of DeepSeek Harness to create custom plugins, like a 3D model renderer and a video editing workbench  —  DeepSeek has unveiled a new option to quickly create custom plugins that help users to tackle a range of complex tasks …

item.title: Anthropic confirms new Claude Code limits "to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game", saying IP infringement violates its usage policy (Bruno Ferreira/Tom's Hardware)
item.description:
Bruno Ferreira / Tom's Hardware:
Anthropic confirms new Claude Code limits “to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game”, saying IP infringement violates its usage policy  —  Meanwhile, we now have direct reports of reverse engineering efforts being blocked, while online complaints grow.

Original (direct link): https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/artificial-intelligence/anthropic-confirms-new-claude-code-limits-to-prevent-game-cloning-users-report-opus-5-5-is-also-actively-blocking-reverse-engineering-tasks

item.title: Israeli startup 42AI, which is developing a "behavioral world model" that tries to predict human behavior, emerges from stealth with a $62.5M seed (Ram Iyer/TechCrunch)
item.description:
Ram Iyer / TechCrunch:
Israeli startup 42AI, which is developing a “behavioral world model” that tries to predict human behavior, emerges from stealth with a $62.5M seed  —  Here's a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?

Original (direct link): https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/42ai-comes-out-of-stealth-with-62-5m-and-a-world-model-that-can-predict-human-behavior/

item.description:

Putin orders owners of non-state data centers to reserve 10% of capacity for Russia's IT infrastructure after Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian facilities  —  Russian owners of non-state data centres will be required to reserve 10% of their capacity to help keep Russia's IT infrastructure running …

item.title: Email: OpenAI plans to merge ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs on desktop for select users before rolling it out widely; Codex "will remain a separate experience" (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
item.description:
Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch:
Email: OpenAI plans to merge ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs on desktop for select users before rolling it out widely; Codex “will remain a separate experience”  —  The ChatGPT desktop app can be a confusing piece of software, given that there are ChatGPT and Codex sections, and within the former, there are Chat and Work tabs.

Original (direct link): https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/openai-is-finally-merging-chatgpts-chat-and-work-tabs/
